title: Why Pineapple's Eyes Aren't Just Cute?

scenes.text: 12 pineapples' eyes hide a secret you can grow
Each eye is actually an individual flower that fused into the fruit
A pineapple produces only one fruit, and the eyes are the remnants of that flower cluster
Those eyes can be planted to grow a brand‑new pineapple plant
Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.

description: The tiny eyes on a pineapple aren’t just decorative—they’re each a former flower that can sprout a whole new plant. Learn the surprising way to propagate pineapples from those spots.
